mapper.select: SELECT menu_id FROM sys_role_menu WHERE role_id = #{roleId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY menu_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_role_menu (id, role_id, menu_id, deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{roleId}, #{menuId}, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_role_menu SET deleted = 1 WHERE role_id = #{roleId} AND deleted = 0
